name: TradingAgents
description: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
one_liner: A framework where a team of specialized AI 'analysts' (one for news, one for fundamentals, one for risk, etc.) debate and vote on trading decisions, mimicking how a real investment committee works.
buyer: A retail trading enthusiast or small boutique fund that wants to experiment with structured, multi-perspective AI trade analysis.
business_use_cases: A finance content creator publishes a daily 'AI investment committee' newsletter summarizing the framework's analysis and recommendations.
A boutique research shop offers backtesting-as-a-service, running the framework against a client's strategy ideas.
A fintech startup uses it as a research layer feeding into a broader robo-advisor product.

money_ideas.idea: Publish a paid daily/weekly newsletter of the framework's analysis, with clear 'not financial advice' disclaimers.
Offer one-off backtesting reports to small funds evaluating a strategy idea.

steal_this: Launch a subscription newsletter presenting its daily multi-agent stock analysis as 'food for thought,' not certified advice — real regulatory and liability homework required before charging real money.
